mapper.select: SELECT s.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , r.CUSTOMER_NAME AS customerName , r.CUSTOMER_TEL AS customerTel , r.CUSTOMER_ADDR AS customerAddr , s.START_TIME AS startTime , s.END_TIME AS endTime , r.STATUS AS status FROM AS_SCHEDULE s JOIN REQUEST r ON s.REQUEST_NO = r.REQUEST_NO JOIN ENGINEER e ON s.ENGINEER_NO = e.ENGINEER_NO WHERE e.MEM_NO = #{memNo} AND YEAR(s.START_TIME) = #{year} AND MONTH(s.START_TIME) = #{month} ORDER BY s.START_TIME;

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , r.REQUEST_NO AS requestNo , r.CUSTOMER_NAME AS customerName , r.CUSTOMER_TEL AS customerTel , r.CUSTOMER_ADDR AS customerAddr , r.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType , r.SYMPTOM AS symptom , r.REQUEST_DATE AS requestDate , s.START_TIME AS visitStart , s.END_TIME AS visitEnd FROM AS_SCHEDULE s JOIN REQUEST r ON s.REQUEST_NO = r.REQUEST_NO WHERE s.SCHEDULE_NO = #{scheduleNo};

SELECT RESULT_NO , SCHEDULE_NO , PROCESS_DATE , PROCESS_CONTENT , IMAGE_PATH , IMAGE_PATH2 , NO_PHOTO_REASON , CREATED_AT , UPDATED_AT FROM AS_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_NO = #{scheduleNo} ORDER BY RESULT_NO DESC LIMIT 1;
